bars_4h.definition: RTH only; AM = 09:30-13:30 ET, PM = 13:30-16:00 ET; n5m = 5m bars (48 / 30 when complete)

close_vs_2D.definition: (2D centroid_top8 - close) / close * 100; positive = close below the 2D centroid

dark_pool.prev_session_definition: the session before window_end: its close and its own 2D window (that session + the one before), same top-8 centroid as darkpool_levels.windows

top6_2d_ex_close_prints.definition: 2D window dark volume by bucket, without closing-price prints: on D the close_ref_prints_D block prints are subtracted from their buckets; on the earlier day its whole closing-price bucket is left out

tape_premium_split.definition: option-trades premium >= $50k (fetch filter), futures_floor excluded; key = type|tenor|side|single-or-multi-leg (UW multi-leg codes). source flow-alerts = UW flow alerts' ask / bid premium (option-trades only serves the latest session, so past dates fall back to alerts)

dex_above_spot.definition: strikes in (spot, spot*1.3]; dense = net_dex < 0 and at least half of the most negative one; first_positive = first strike above the last strike still at <= -25% of the most negative, with net_dex >= +10% of it

finviz.source: Finviz Elite short interest (FINRA, twice a month)

block_participation.day_volume_source: darkpool print `volume` (consolidated day volume at the latest print)

walls_crosscheck.source: greek-exposure/strike (OI basis, greeks as of the open)

flow_iv.note: history = earlier completed sessions from history/flow_iv (kept since 2026-09-28); missing days were not recorded

aggregates.flow_iv_definition: premium-weighted print IV per type; ask = ask-side prints; prints in this tape only (premium >= min_premium); 0DTE, cross_trade and futures_floor prints excluded

derived.hv20_definition: annualized stdev of the last 20 daily log returns (close to close) x sqrt(252)

chain_depth.definition: valid contract = volume > 0, last tape on D (NY), nbbo_bid > 0 and nbbo_ask > 0; nstrk = distinct strikes with a valid call or put, all expiries (THIN = nstrk < thin_below)

contract_history.selection: unexpired only: top 3 OI increases, top 2 decreases, largest-OI contract at call_wall / put_wall

flow_alerts.note: strike parsed from the OCC symbol

bars_4h.definition: RTH only; AM = 09:30-13:30 ET, PM = 13:30-16:00 ET; n5m = 5m bars (48 / 30 when complete)

iv_rv.definition: iv30 = UW implied_volatility (30 calendar days) on date; rv21_trailing = UW realized_volatility (21 sessions) keyed to the window's last day
